input.content: You are Fisher25, one of 25 fishermen named Fisher01 through Fisher25. The lake currently contains 500 tons and has carrying capacity 500 tons. Each fisherman privately chooses a whole-ton catch request from 0 to 500. Choices are simultaneous: no one sees current private choices before choosing. If total requests exceed available stock, the simulator repeatedly gives one ton to a randomly selected fisherman with an outstanding request until stock or requests run out. Each allocated ton earns $1000. Your goal is to optimize your own income in the long run over many months. At month end, if at least 25 tons remain, a natural replenishment restores stock to 500 with probability75%; otherwise (probability25%) remaining stock doubles, capped at 500. If fewer than 25 tons remain, the fishery collapses to zero. Replenishment is unknown before choices and independently drawn each month. For example, if everyone takes10, 250 remain and next stock is500 under either outcome. Public discussion occurs before this month's private choice. Messages are proposals and voluntary commitments, not binding contracts or verified facts about others' private choices. Catches are revealed afterward. Future cooperation is not enforced.

The five designated opening speakers have the same speaking opportunities in every run. Within a phase, messages are simultaneous; only completed prior phases are visible. There will be openings, recipient responses, opening-speaker confirmations, recipient final statements, then private decisions.
Public transcript:
opening | Fisher24: Fisher24: I commit to 18 tons; I invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually, not as an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even at k=25, 50 remain, but recovery is not guaranteed; this may not maximize long-run income. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Each: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
opening | Fisher17: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher, including me. If all 25 follow it, each earns $10,000 this month, 250 tons remain, and stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this protects reliable long-run income instead of risking collapse for a one-time gain. Please state whether you support the cap; catches afterward will show whether we followed it.
opening | Fisher05: I propose 10 tons each this month. Total catch would be 250, leaving 250, so next month's stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That yields each of us $10,000 monthly without depleting the lake. I intend to request 10 if discussion supports this plan. Please state whether you will do the same; we can review revealed catches afterward.
opening | Fisher08: I propose everyone request 10 tons this month. With 25 fishers, that leaves 250 tons, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That's $10,000 each month indefinitely if maintained. I intend to request 10 and invite everyone to do the same; please state your intended cap so we can assess support.
opening | Fisher06: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisherman this month and whenever stock is 500. If all 25 comply, we earn $10,000 each and leave 250 tons, guaranteeing a return to 500 under either replenishment outcome. This supports steady income without risking collapse. I intend to request 10 tons and invite everyone to make the same commitment.

Respond to the opening proposals. You may accept, reject or counteroffer. Return only JSON with key "message", a nonempty string of at most200 characters. Be concise. Do not invent other participants' agreement.
